vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Label vulnerability-driven pull requests security and merge them on green CI after a bake as long as pnpm's default release-age floor, so ecosystems outside npm get the same guard

lockFileMaintenance.description: Open the lock file refresh past the concurrent limit, so transitive dependency fixes keep reaching develop

packageRules.description: Exempt update types that carry no release timestamp from the minimum release-age bake, so their renovate/stability-days check can resolve under internalChecksFilter:strict
The release_versions endpoint Renovate reads carries no release timestamps, so a release-age bake here would never resolve its renovate/stability-days check under internalChecksFilter:strict
Rebase non-npm updates only on conflict: they leave pnpm-lock.yaml alone, so a merge to develop needn't rerun their CI
Rebase minor and patch updates when behind: they share a branch with npm updates that change pnpm-lock.yaml, and a group rebases as its first-sorted member does

Update each of these dependencies in its own pull request that moves every pin at once, so develop never holds two versions of it. Placed after the minor and patch rule so these branches rebase only on conflict
Rebase pnpm updates when behind: a new pnpm rewrites pnpm-lock.yaml
Move engines and @types/node to a new Node.js major only once it reaches LTS
Leave devcontainer features to their annotations: on a digest-only feature the devcontainer manager follows the latest tag across majors
Leave genshin-db to the game data refresh: a release needs the generators run alongside the pin, which Renovate can't do
Keep deploy-cloudrun majors manual: it has no dry-run mode, so no required check can exercise it before it deploys

customManagers.description: Track each devcontainer feature's digest within its annotated tag: the devcontainers CLI rejects a feature reference carrying both
